title: Planned berth at Granadilla, Tenerife (12:00 local)
body: Oceanwide Expeditions has formally requested to dock at Granadilla port at 12:00 noon on May 9. On arrival, Spanish authorities are scheduled to perform a full epidemiological investigation, examine and treat all passengers and crew, then transfer them onward — with symptomatic individuals and Spanish nationals quarantined at a military hospital in Madrid, and foreign passengers repatriated through EU civil protection. Disinfection of the vessel follows.
